people.name: Aaron
people.line: Moses' brother, first high priest of Israel

translations.web: Aaron said, “Don’t let the anger of my lord grow hot. You know the people, that they are set on evil.
translations.bsb: “Do not be enraged, my lord,” Aaron replied. “You yourself know that the people are intent on evil.
translations.kjv: And Aaron said, Let not the anger of my lord wax hot: thou knowest the people, that they are set on mischief.
translations.asv: And Aaron said, Let not the anger of my lord wax hot: thou knowest the people, that they are set on evil.
